title: Accounts
key_points: XRP Ledger accounts are used for sending and receiving XRP and other assets.
Each account has a public key, which is derived from a secret seed phrase.
The XRP Ledger uses the SHA-256 hash function to derive account addresses from secret keys.
Accounts can be created by anyone with knowledge of their secret seed, regardless of their balance or whether they have XRP.
Accounts in the XRP Ledger are not tied to real-world identities and have no associated personal information.
limitations: The source is technical documentation and may use jargon or assume prior knowledge.
It focuses on the XRP Ledger's technical aspects rather than its broader applications or implications.
